tasks.title: Notebook execution trust gate
tasks.outcome: Notebook execution fails closed without explicit project trust, permission, and per-run opt-in.

verification.expected_initial: implementation is incomplete or the named post-implementation verification has not passed
verification.expected_success: command exits 0 and all acceptance assertions pass

acceptance: Unknown or untrusted roots, environment-only enablement, revoked approval, path escape, and non-regular notebooks are rejected without starting a process.
Only an approved trusted run enters the executor and every denial records the controlling policy decision.
